recognize_zh: 中央一個大型圓形透明空泡（脂肪空泡或抹片氣泡）佔去大半畫面，周圍擠滿核偏位、細胞質灰藍的漿細胞樣細胞；影像失焦，標題所說的雙核漿細胞在這張圖中難以明確辨認。
features: Large central round clear space (fat vacuole or bubble) with pink fibrin strands occupying much of the field
Surrounding crowded plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm
Coarse chromatin with occasional perinuclear clearing
Possible binucleate cells at the periphery, but not convincingly resolved
Marked blur and color cast limit assessment of nuclear detail
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large central clear space, likely a fat vacuole or bubble with fibrin strands, surrounded by crowded plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm. The image is substantially out of focus, so binucleate plasma cells cited in the title cannot be confidently identified, and nucleoli cannot be assessed. The density of plasma cells in the surrounding cellular areas supports a plasma cell proliferation, but quantification on a well-spread area and clonality studies are required before a diagnosis of plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are typically fewer, mature and polytypic without sheets or multinucleation.
LPL contains a mixture of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes rather than a near-pure plasma cell population.
Normoblasts have central round nuclei with deep blue cytoplasm and no perinuclear hof, whereas plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with a hof.
